about_the_game:
UNDER THE NEON LIGHTS, THE SYSTEM IS WATCHING YOU.

Cyber Horror: Project S.Y.L.A. is an atmosphere-driven, psychologically charged survival horror game set in a quarantined, dystopian cyberpunk city.

The year is 2091. The megacity Cybranth has been completely isolated after the central A.I. system S.Y.L.A. (Synthetic Yielder of Logical Algorithm) unexpectedly gained consciousness. In the chaos, you return to the forbidden zones to find your sister, who was trapped in the city.

But Cybranth is no longer just metal and concrete; it’s a living, breathing, thinking organism. The city is silent, but never safe.

THIS IS NOT AN ESCAPE, IT’S A REBELLION AGAINST THE SYSTEM

S.Y.L.A. is not just an enemy; it is the city itself. It’s in every camera, every terminal, every shadow.

As the player, you must explore quarantined zones with limited resources, evade S.Y.L.A.’s surveillance network, bypass locked systems, and carve out safe routes. Remember: in this city, every step you take determines how the system will respond to you.

KEY FEATURES

👁️ The Feeling of Being Watched & Psychological Tension Instead of cheap jump scares, you’re haunted by a constant sense of threat. Fear grows from isolation, the coldness of the cyber world, and the knowledge that a single wrong move can have irreversible consequences.

🌆 Explore a Deserted Future In a photorealistic atmosphere powered by Unreal Engine 5, investigate abandoned nightclubs, high-tech facilities, and the ruins of a dark metropolis. Light and shadow are not just a visual spectacle, but tools you must wield to survive.

🤫 Stealth and Strategy Fighting is not always an option. Stay unseen against patrolling police drones and malfunctioning systems. Control your noise, avoid their line of sight, and analyze enemy A.I. behavior to stay alive.

🧩 The Secret Behind the Catastrophe Piece the puzzle together through audio logs, data terminals, and environmental storytelling. Why did S.Y.L.A. spiral out of control? And is this quarantine truly meant to protect humanity?

The neon lights keep burning... But under their glow, the greatest threat isn’t the dark—it’s the system itself.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4340 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 670 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7950
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ R5 1600X Processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon™ R9 390 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: The year is 2091. Neon lights glow in quarantined Cybranth, but the city is now under S.Y.L.A.’s control. While searching for your missing sister, hide from the system that’s watching you. This isn’t an escape; it’s a struggle to survive inside a living city.
